messages:
Maya: Quick check — thinking we compress the nightly handoff from 30m to 20m starting next week to reduce meeting bloat. Thoughts? Also want to rotate an escalation lead for the 00:00-06:00 UTC window. Proposed schedule below.

Sam: +1 to shorter if we keep the same agenda. Can we try 20m for two weeks and then retro?

Jordan: My concern is the open P2 (model-serving cache thrash). Need someone senior on the triage call until it's mitigated. @Maya can we pin an escalation owner?

Maya: Good point. Proposal: keep a fixed escalation lead for a full week (Mon-Sun) to avoid handoff gaps. Week starting Apr 7: @Jordan, Apr 14: @Lee, Apr 21: @Emily. Thoughts?

Lee: Works for me. If a lead can't attend, they should post proxy in the incident thread and assign via Jira. :thumbsup:

Emily: Fine. Also request: add a short "status muting" line to the agenda so we only surface unmuted alerts. Keeps the call short.

Maya: Agreed. Draft agenda: (copy into calendar/event description)

```
1) Quick rollcall (2m)
2) New/severe incidents summary (6m)
3) Escalation owner actions / blockers (6m)
4) Handoff notes + outstanding tasks (4m)
5) Quick followups + assign owners (2m)
```

Maya: Will try 20m on Mon and collect feedback Wed. Can someone update the calendar invites to 20m and add the agenda snippet?

Sam: I'll update invites and add the agenda to the event description. @opsbot please post a pointer to the incident board at start.

opsbot: calendar-bot: calendar updated by Sam. Incident board link will be posted to channel at start of each call. :robot_face: 

Jordan: For the P2 cache issue — adding EMERGENCY label on the incident; @Lee will take the first triage after midnight UTC tonight.

Lee: On it. Will also drop a brief playbook note in the incident.

Maya: Thanks. If this experiment looks bad, we revert to 30m. Quick poll: thumbs up if you can attend Mon 20m format.

Sam: :thumbsup:

Jordan: :thumbsup:

Lee: :thumbsup:

Emily: :thumbs_up:

Maya: Great — I'll update the runbook and calendar. Will send a brief follow-up with retrospective questions mid-week.
